card.name: The word care after supportive
card.fires_on: The word "care" right after "supportive" (usually "general supportive care") in overdosage sections of drug labels.

modes.label: General supportive care
modes.description: "care" completes the phrase "general supportive care" in overdose management text.
modes.example: There is no specific treatment for overdose with fenofibric acid. General supportive<< care>> of the patient is indicated, including monitoring

modes.label: Supportive care without general
modes.description: "care" follows "supportive" alone, as an instruction or in a treatment list.
modes.example: Provide supportive<< care>> including close medical supervision and monitoring.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated word pieces such as Mature, studio and Composer, so there is no clear output effect.
